title: The tiger, the bears and the snakes
content:
Let's get to the point. Saw a dream, it started with Riny and me walking to a house we were living in. It was a pretty forested area. Seemed like it rained just a while ago. The house was not that well kept from the look of it from outside but the area was perfect. Secluded from humans and surrounded by forest from three sides. On our path we saw a tiger in behind a fence and the house behind that fenced area way back in the distance. Tiger was just doing his thing not minding us. Not a single thought of danger crossed our minds. I'm not sure if there was some part in after that I forgot but the next thing I remember was I alone in a local restaurant. I was there for food, people asked me about Riny's whereabouts, I was replied them that I myself don't know. I took my plate of food and sat comfortably on the porch of the restaurant. I made sure that I sit the way I want and not care what other people would think about me. The restaurant was run by a old local couple. The wife saw me settling down to eat and gave me a warm nod. I ate my food and after that I asked the male owner (the husband) if he had seen Riny. There was a communication problem all this while. I switched to Hindi and immediately he answered he had seen Riny an hour ago walking on the road in front of the restaurant alone. I asked which direction did she went last. He pointed me to the right. I went to look for her. Uptil now I was not afraid and there was nothing negative to feel.

I was walking looking at my phone when suddenly I stopped when I sensed barbed wire less than a half a feet from my face. The whole path was closed with barb wire yet there was a little hole on the left side. I went through the hole when I got a call from Shakti instigating if I was working. I told him that I haven't reached home yet. Seems like this dream was from just after our office trip to Bhimtal. Still he was suspicious of me and asked for a screenshot from my laptop. I didn't tell him that I was out. I lied and told him okay, I'm giving the screenshot and immediately turned back from that path. I abandoned my search for Riny. I started running for our house. On the way I crossed the restaurant, I sensed people seeing me running back, Shakti suspiciously asked what the sound was, I said nothing. It was me panting from running. On the way I had to cross a house roof. This was the place I saw that tiger before. Climbing on the roof and getting to the other side of the house was the only way to get to my house. This was the normal path. When I was on the roof I dropped the keys below to the left side of this house and in panic I dropped the phone as well. I thought now it's going to take time to send that screenshot to him. I still didn't gave up. I don't know why. I got down from the roof to the side of the house, I couldn't see the phone or my house key anywhere. I now was inside the fence where tiger was before. But there was no sign of tiger so I was not worrying about that. I worried about not being able to communicate to Shakti. I saw the key in a crevasse at the side of the house and I got down a little further down to get it. When I got the key I saw it was not made of steel or any metal like before, it was made of stone. I thought someone would have made a copy of my key. In the next scene I was facing the side of the house on which I was supposed to cross and my back to my house in the distance standing inside the fence. A bear behind me growled but didn't attck me, although he/she could have easily killed me that instance. Now I dropped my plan to send that screenshot to Shakti and feared for my life. I immediately ran away from the bear and climbed on the roof from the the side of the house. Then I saw black and yellow snakes, 7-8 feet long. One after another snake started appearing inside the fence. Then standing on the roof I saw bear and couple of bear cubs started to attack the snakes. I thought to myself, the brighter the color the more poisonous the snake. I saw snakes climbing the fence and fall on the my side with a clear audible thud. I didn't know what to do. Not once the thought of going back in the direction of the restaurant crossed my mind. Then I saw two snakes on the top most part of the roof of the house I was standing on fighting and twirling into one another. One was black and white and the other one was black and yellow. This was the only black and white snake. They both fell down while fighting, the black and white snake fell from the roof and the other snake, the black and yellow one fell on the slope of the roof in front of me and bounced over me and got on a higher roof behind me. I was completely unsafe and felt this was too much to handle and I woke up.

title: Anima and Animus
content:
The conquest of the anima as an autonomous complex, and her transformation into a function of relationship between the conscious and the unconscious. With the attainment of this goal, it becomes possible to disengage the ego from all its entanglements with collectivity [that is, the persona field] and the collective unconscious. Through this process the anima forfeits the daemonic power of an autonomous complex: she can no longer exercise the power of possession since she is depotentiated. She is no longer the guardian of treasures unknown; no longer Kundry, daemonic Messenger of the Grail, half-divine, and half-animal; no longer is the soul to be called “Mistress,” but a psychological function of an intuitive nature, akin to what the primitives mean when they say, “He has gone into the forest to talk with the spirits” or “My snake spoke with me” or, in the mythological language of infancy, “A little bird told me.”

Now when the anima loses her mana, what becomes of it? Clearly the man who has mastered the anima acquires her mana, in accordance with the primitive belief that when a man kills the mana-person he assimilates his mana into his own body.

Well then: who is it that has integrated the anima? Obviously the conscious ego, and therefore the ego has taken over the mana. Thus the ego becomes a mana-personality. But the mana-personality is a dominant of the collective unconscious, the well-known archetype of the mighty man in the form of hero, chief, magician, medicine-man, saint, the ruler of men and spirits, the friend of God.

To withdraw the projection means to transform the anima “into a function of relationship between the conscious and the unconscious.” The anima then becomes “a psychological function of an intuitive nature, akin to what the primitives mean when they say, ‘He has gone into the forest to talk with the spirits.’” He might well be describing Majnun.

This is an exciting and vivid passage, but not a model of clarity. To unravel what Jung is saying, we have to recall the central argument of Two Essays, which Jung alludes to here in the second sentence. Individuation is a process of differentiating oneself from the two collectivities: that of the persona field and that of the collective unconscious. We must establish a living relationship with these two domains, but not be absorbed by either of them. He says nothing about what the persona field contributes to anima possession -- although the example of Heathcliff gives us a hint of this -- the aim of incorporating the woman who carries our anima projection into our persona strategies.

Most of the passage describes the archetypal power, or mana, of the anima and how it takes away the personal autonomy and free decision power of our ego. What he says about feeling powerless in the face of the anima’s occult and bewitching mana, which overwhelms me with ideas and emotions that are simultaneously unwelcome and yet so compelling I can’t give them up -- all this we know quite well.

Thus, the first and better solution to the problem of anima projection means that I detach the unconscious image which masks my beloved and bring it back inside, where it ceases to be an image for me to worship. It ceases even to be the object of my meditation. It is no longer even an image. Instead, it becomes transparent, a kind of channel for intuition that puts me into reliable touch with archetypal realities that are greater than I am and which have important things to say to me -- like the birds that sang for Majnun and Layla.

No doubt you’ve noticed, here, that there’s no talk of the person of my beloved. She’s evidently merely an occasion to provoke me into doing my “inner work.” We’ve slipped into solipsism again. But a truly new idea is articulated. The anima -- or animus -- becomes a “function of relationship” and a channel for intuition. Anima and animus are no longer functioning as masks, but have become something more like lenses to bring intuitive reality into focus.

title: Notes#4: Anima
content:
Anima’s main enticement is the promise of the best, most meaningful relationship of a man’s life if he goes the distance. He gets to marry his dream girl. She can be mom, lover, wife, muse, goddess, princess and best friend all in one—but usually not all at the same time. At least, not till the end of the process. Instead, as a male matures through his lifetime relationship with anima, she evolves. She first appears as a mother figure. When he reaches his teen years she morphs into an ideal lover. When he matures into manhood, anima matures along with him, becoming a mature and independent female. Finally, she evolves into a goddess figure such as the Virgin Mary or the Hindu’s Devi, the Divine Mother. Unfortunately, it’s easy to get fixated at an early stage of development and never evolve beyond it.

The ideal "Mother" is different from the mortal Mother. The ideal mother is my projection of needs and standards whereas, the mortal mother has to fulfill the ideals set for her. Characters like anima arise from the deepest reaches of the psyche and are independent of the ego. They’re archetypes. The personal expression of your archetypes is shaped through a lifetime of experience. Archetypes are blueprints that shape personality, behavior, and processes of thought and feeling. You are born with archetypes as basically rough outlines that are the same in everyone. A male’s mother or primary female caregiver is the first image given to his anima. She isn’t just his mother; she’s Mother, a Goddess, the giver of life. His mortal mother is used to fill in the details provided by the archetype’s blueprint. Then the image is filled in throughout his lifetime by experiences with females of all types, but especially the ones closest to him. Anima is the main representative of a man’s unconscious mind.

title: The Essence of Engineering
content:
I have been programming for the last six years, two and a half years of competitive programming and the rest web development. To me competitive programming did feel like engineering but web dev does not. Web development, especially frontend is not much engineering. Six years in and now I want to be an engineer through and through. People are setting off for Mars and I'm here centering text in a div. Both are called "Engineering", but how can I consider myself to be in their category? The difference in impact, skill and thrill is so damn much, how can I deny that I'm not wasting my time. It doesn't matter how good I get at web development, I will always feel like my mind could be better utilized in System Engineering or Machine Learning on solving the unsolvable. Web development is full of unsolvable tasks, you say? I disagree, web dev is not about solving the unsolvable, at the very best it's about new ideas, doing something that has not been done before and that too only in browser.

At the end of the day, coding web is not the bottleneck, it's the idea. You see that's why startups are unicorn-ing based on new ideas, rarely do any of these have new/exceptional tech. Idea or a necessity is what drives innovation in web dev while as of early 2020, fields like machine learning have a lot of stuff still undiscovered, so a lot of room to innovate themselves which in turn paves way for new ideas, ideas which were unthought of or laughable once. In this age the result of web development is clear while in fields like AI the result in unknown. We don't know what or how much more it can do. All this time in web development while I was "developing software", I was coding not programming. What I want to say is, I want to be a far better programmer and not be a coder in the very least. It's time to get out of the browser and into the real world of engineering.

I know it feels like I'm dissing web development, but I'm not. I guess, to each his own. I love web development for what it is. The problem is that it gets complex at it's extreme but not hard. Harder to keep the big picture in mind when it gets complex, yes, but it has the same flow and predefined set of rules to follow even in backend. I still find web dev fun at my job. It's not hard so I give myself illogical deadlines to feel the thrill I felt back in competitive programming days. Web development though fun, $$$ and useful, I cannot consider it to be something prestigious, while on the other hand, system engineering, machine learning and solving the unsolvable seem prestigious to me. I guess because there are a lot less people setting on to solve the unsolvable.

If I have confidence in my tech and have two or more ideas which have never been used together before, this alone can get me pretty far. To me engineering is not replicating the exact flow of what others have done millions of times (eg: web dev), the essence of engineering is felt in real-time, it's a way of thinking, to know how to compartmentalise, to water down the noise, to be able to know what's noise and what's gold, to reduce the problem down to dimensions we can comprehend (mathematics), to to build upon previous feats, to look with multiple perspectives, to be able to use human research already done in wide variety of fields inorder to come up with new seemless solutions. That's what I think true engineering is.

P.S. By unsolvable I mean unsolvable yet.

title: Notes#2: Logos and Eros
content:
Woman's psychology is founded on the principle of Eros, the great binder and loosener, whereas from ancient times the ruling principle ascribed to man is Logos. The concept of Eros could be expressed in modern terms as psychic relatedness, and that of Logos as objective interest.
By Logos, I meant discrimination, judgment, insight, and by Eros, I meant the capacity to relate.I regarded both concepts as intuitive ideas which cannot be defined accurately or exhaustively. From the scientific point of view this is regrettable, but from a practical one it has its value, since the two concepts mark out a field of experience which it is equally difficult to define.
As we can hardly ever make a psychological proposition without immediately having to reverse it, instances to the contrary leap to the eye at once: men who care nothing for discrimination, judgment, and insight, and women who display an almost excessively masculine proficiency in this respect. … Wherever this exists, we find a forcible intrusion of the unconscious, a corresponding exclusion of the consciousness specific to either sex, predominance of the shadow and of contrasexuality. [“The Personification of the Opposites,” CW 14, pars. 224f.]

This gendering of eros and logos is a consequence of Jung's theory of the anima/animus syzygy of the human psyche. Syzygy refers to the split between male and female. According to Jung, this split is recapitulated in the unconscious mind by means of "contrasexual" (opposite-gendered) elements called the anima (in men) and the animus (in women). Thus men have an unconscious feminine principle, the "anima", which is characterized by feminine eros. The work of individuation for men involves becoming conscious of the anima and learning to accept it as one's own, which entails accepting eros. This is necessary in order to see beyond the projections that initially blind the conscious ego. "Taking back the projections" is a major task in the work of individuation, which involves owning and subjectivizing unconscious forces which are initially regarded as alien.

Logos is the masculine psychological principle, its rationalism, power, ego, materialism, atheism, nihilism, atoms, (late french-german)existentialism, materialistic science, Nietzsche, Freud, depression. Eros is the female psychological principle, its relatedness, emotions, love, creativity, dreams, music, religion, ancient greek philosophy psychedelics, Kierkegaard, Jung, psychosis. Too much Logos leads to meaninglessness (depression), too much Eros leads to seeing meaning in everything (psychosis). Their polar opposite energies in the pleroma of separation. For example, Elon Musks simulation theory and the Buddhist Source theory is the same theory but the first is expressed in Logos while the second is expressed in Eros.
Note: a common mistake is to believe logos are male and eros is female, this is wrong as both men and woman have both principles, an example of a feminine symbol of Logos is the greek god Athene, an example of a masculine symbol of Eros is Apollo

The way most men are conditioned often involves a lot of shaming of anything that may appear weak, vulnerable or emotional (Eros). Such shaming is one powerful source that fuels Jung’s gender split (syzygy) in the psyche. In other words, as men, these aspects of ourselves that are not supported and allowed to flourish, “go underground” and energize the Anima (or Animus for women, who have other conditioning).

So, the Anima and Eros, which is unconscious for traditionally conditioned men often includes important elements of relationship, which remain undeveloped. It is like parts of himself get left behind and stop developing, interfering with his full functioning. For example, without strong connection to his emotions and vulnerability, a man’s capacity for getting his deeper emotional needs met, and his capacity for empathy, are lacking. This not only leaves him unable to respond on a deep level to his intimate partners, but leaves his deepest wants and desires unfulfilled. title: Pattern Recognition: What's next in tech?
content:
Humble beginnings: The age of digitization

First when computers came to be in 1960s and 70s, they where only used by scientists and the tech savy. It was obvious to the inventors that the real application of this invention is not in scientific research but in the hands of general public. Entrepreneurs like Bill Gates and Steve Jobs(visionary but still, fuck him) among others were the first to realize this, hence putting all their efforts in making computer accessible to the general public for personal use leading to the foundation of Microsoft and Apple. And they where right! Hence, the explosion of applications of computer in every field that existed. Shreading old methods and making everything digital. It was the inventors who started this revolution but, it was the general public who carried this invention to unimaginable heights.

Pattern in the age of globalization

Then in 1980s and 1990s a new invention leveraging computers came to be: The internet. At first it was used only for research and military purposes. But the inventor Tim Berners Lee and his team knew the real power of internet can only be attained when made global, internet was made keeping that in mind but only for Government network at that time. So, on 6th August 1991 internet was opened to the public FOR FREE. All of a sudden an explosion of internet startups occured, hiding away another level of abstraction and making it even easier for general public to use it by creating tools such as internet browser. This revolution was much greater and longer than the previous because it allowed people to connect to each other all around the planet. It served as a precursor, a base on which the age of information was yet to establish itself. Again, the revolution was started by the inventor but it was the general public who carried it through and made the invention what it is right now.

Pattern in the age of information

The mid 1990s but mostly 2000s saw the rise of social networking sites leveraging internet. This started with the invention of Geocities(1994) and AOL instant messenger(1997) where information could be sent and received from anywhere on the planet in miliseconds. The potential of these inventions easily surpassed old methods such as landline, newspaper and the way people connect with each other. This led to another revolution: The fifth estate. Everything could be found on the internet and general public would themself upload their information on the internet. New inventions were made on top of previous inventions(computer, internet) but, it was again the general public driving the revolution.

Pattern in the age of automation

Started mostly in 2010s meaning we are currently living in the age of automation. The age of information generated(and is still generating) unfathomable amount of data every day which lead to the age of automation. Hence, the next big thing: Artificial Intelligence was born (technically, it was born in 1950s but back then we neither had data nor fast enough hardware to process any meaning out of it.) Again, tools were invented by the visionaries who predicted the changing market, social and economic needs. Using the tools countless applications of AI came into existence. The contribution of general public in this age is their data hence, it's again the general public who's responsible for driving the revolution.

The future: Man and machine as one.

The pattern I see everytime is that, at first a technology is invented, then a platform is created by the early ones, the visionaries who realize it's potential, then it's let loose to the general public to leverage that technology and the explosion occurs. One can argue that in the age of automation general public is not directly influencing the revolution. Data is key to automation and that data is produced by general public but still, they are not the ones processing the data, it's the Data Scientists. And I think this argument is correct. It's like Youtube has been invented but, only Youtube employees can upload video. That's the state of AI right now. It needs general public to explode, just like in the case of Youtube, Instagram, Medium etc. But, the age of automation hasn't ended yet.

title: MS#20: Make way, I have time

On which my fetishism for depression would feast upon no later than tomorrow. What did I even do last night? I just tried understanding my rumination over those two. I don't completely believe in this theory and I'm quite surprised that I didn't thought about it myself already. I'm talking about what Jordan Peterson said — If something from the past has been bothering you, it's because you've not articulated it. I don't know if it matters.

I've thinking more and more about the condition I'm in, it's surprisingly stupid or sad (depends on perspective.) The two most factual things I could get out of this was firstly, that all this rumination and lament is worthless, it changes nothing from their sides and secondly, that I've been using those two for emotional stimulation, because I need something—anything to feel, pleasure or pain, I don't care. I am bored and when nothing comes to my ideal mind, it's starts thinking about all the things that has once touched me. Although, I've noticed a pattern in this, I only think about the things which are sad, depraved, depressing and lost such as those two, competitive programming and even May 2017. If I'm so keen on wanting to feel something then why don't I ever try to feel happiness? An explanation could be that I'm trying to make myself feel pain voluntarily just because I like it. I'm addicted to it. When ever I think about them I feel the pain which is straight forward and understandable but, I feel pleasure as well!

However, the underground man is intensely consious of any act of depravity, and consequently,
takes pleasure from his depravity by being aware of it. — Fyodor Dostoevsky

My attraction towards pain has grown, even in clear flashes of optimism and even when I feel love for all things sublime and beautiful, I feel like I'm losing something. I feel an intense longing for the pain, and knowing the sources which can deliver that amount of pain, how can I let them go? But, when I'm in deep mire, I again feel bad about all of it, then and only then I feel longing for the light.

I'm not able to make my mind on what do I want, eternal pain or the hard life of Sisyphus? I long for both and I seem to want the another only when I have the other. Maybe, the solution is to alternate between them. As for solution, all I can come up with is that I need something in my life going on. Like some project, book or girlfriend. As I'm writing this I feel how hard this is going to be. My inclination towards the dark is very prominent. But, whatever, this is the solution. If you want pain then derive it off of new pleasures, not the past ones. I can't allow you to ruminate over the things that don't matter.

title: MS#19: The Sorcerer
content:

If I have something more intriguing I will get distracted, no doubt I will. My problem is loneliness and my confusion on things if they are achievable or not. Like happiness and satisfaction.

I do know that both happiness and satisfaction are achievable but are temporary and therefore, will have to be earned again. I guess the question here is: Is it worth it? Happiness and satisfaction both are doomed to be gone. Why would I want to work over and over again for the thing that is bound to not exist. I know what I think about all this, it is to give up on everything and keep floating without any responsibility. But I've done that several times before. I want to give up. I also know what is to be done in this situation i.e The myth of Sisyphus. It's what christ did; to bear the burden of the cross of the entire world. I know I'm not making much sense.

I need to find something to keep myself indulged. I don't have anything to do and that's why it has become easier to fall in to the loneliness pit.

There's this unsettling angst, you know? There's no satisfaction anywhere. I can keep on fulfilling my urges but nothing happens! Nothing ever happens! There's nothing wrong with me. Definitely, I have more that required. I have good relations with the ones I want (that can be better, I know.) Then why? Why sad? Why this suffering? Is suffering a way for me to feel something, anything. Because the boredom is much worst? I'm not talking about your everyday boredom. I am talking about the thing that you feel when your complete life is right in front of you to see. To see that nothing will ever change, nothing remains that could make you feel a different way. To also see that nothing can ever be done to make it otherwise. Everything in life becomes colorless, the feeling of surprise gone forever. title: Notes#1

Communism

The idea of a society where every individual contributes his share and the state controls everything, from distribution of resources according to need to abolition private property and class system. Absence of money and ownership to establish social order. The problem with communism is that it does not reward the hard working individuals while practically rewarding the ones not working hard as everyone is only required to do as much as they want to and rewarding according to necessity. Therefore, not encouraging hard work to push the frontier is also a shortcoming of cummunism.

Socialism

The state controls but not completely. An example of socialism in today's world is the system of taxes used to fund free-education(nordic countries), hospitals, fire department, road construction etc. i.e equal share in profit and property. The two most prominent variations of socialism are socialist democracy (Finland) and Marxism/Leninism (USSR).

Marxism

Critic of capitalism. Problems with capitalism:

  • Capitalism is alienating.
  • Modern work is insecure(terrified of abandonment).
  • Capitalism is very unstable(crisis of abundance).
  • Capitalism is bad for capitalists(comodity fetishism).
Capitalism -> Socialism -> Communism

title: A world full of nothing
content:
What's the problem here? That's what I want to know. Why can't a man live on his own? Why does he need be esteemed? Where does this need to be esteemed come from, may it be the warmth derived off of family, friend, lover or any other relation? And more importantly, why does a man in the depths of nihilism or even existentialism feel the need to be ensured that he is not alone, that he is not the only one who thinks like that? Why is there a need to base his need for compassion from other people when he clearly knows it doesn't matter? He himself doesn't matter, the people on whom he is counting on don't matter. Then why does he fall into this constant need for assurance from others, be it love or contentment, that he is not alone?

If he is a nihilist he should very well know and understand he is just there. Nothing from the external or internal can ever change anything in him. Life will always be dry, just like the way it always has been and he will always be just there! If he is a pure nihilist (I do think nihilism is binary, but still) he should stop looking for answers, why is there a need to find an answer? As if he could ever escape nihilism. No! If he is a nihilist he should fully believe that there is no answer. He himself should kill his pleasure sources, he should kill the ones he's deriving pleasure from, he should kill the ones he looks up to because they won't be able to trump the nihilism in him. It is widely acclaimed that humans can't live without other humans. But, according to me that's not a complete theory, there's something missing. Humans just seem to want other humans to be beside them because of the warmth of endearment, for the warmth of love. And I say that's why they are in limbo. Because the contentment they get from other humans can't satisfy this urge to have meaning, it can't trump nihilism, the longing doesn't stop. And therefore, humans are useless to other humans.

And a little angel on my side
Tries to make it all worthwhile
And with a little beauty in my bed
I still wish that I was dead — Tiamat, Nihil

It's almost an innate feeling, to want others. Is it even innate? Or this is another concept instilled into us by centuries of brainwash? In the simplest of terms, I just want to ask: What's the need for another human when I quite clearly know it wouldn't make any difference?

Whoever fights monsters should see to it that in the process he does not become a monster. And if you gaze long enough into an abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you.—Fredrich Nietzsche

One reason could be that I know nothing is here forever and I see everyone protecting their advantages so incessantly with all their might. As if it's going to last forever. And that annoys me to the point of paranoia. Which consequently turns into anger and later into bitterness. I have high standards for everyone which is a failed approach from the start. Firstly because no two people are same, everyone has different sets of values and beliefs, why should they believe in my beliefs? Secondly because no one gives a shit about my standards and frankly why should they (a narcissistic trait in me can be observed here.) And thirdly because living up to the standards I set is flat-out hard. I've set the standards because it's easy for a person like me. I have centered it around my beliefs, my values, my skills, my advantages, my fears and my liking. All this, It's just stupid.

Look, I am doomed to be alone for the rest of my life. No one, and I don't say this lightly, absolutely NO ONE can save me from loneliness. How can I trust anyone ever when I'm sure that they themselves would one day deceive their own selves. This is the final frontier, the final conclusion, now only faith can trump this claim. I guess this is why faith was invented. An artificial delusion? Dictated to people for coping up with life. See, this is why religion is needed. Faith is a curious thing, for all a man needs is faith and he has the answer to something infinitely meaningless! Do you think accepting things the way they are, embracing anything that comes, do you think that in some sense is faith?

I've given in to bitterness, I especially warned myself of this, but in vain. I need to forgive people. I unable to see any good in this world all I see are demons. The belief that humans are inherently evil and it's not in their power to change that remains undefeated by any claim. But above all this I still do need to believe that there's something in humans that's tender deep in their hearts, after all the layers of ingratitude there something that's solid in the core and which embraces love. But love towards friends seems like such an act to me. I am not sure of the love towards family. I think I do love them, but my these new voices in my head are clouding everything. And the love for a partner makes me laugh. Why am I incapable of feeling any sort of love towards most people? I have loved, but that was before Notes from the Underground. That book has changed my life for the better or for the worse, I don't quite know. But I do know I need to forgive and I need to trust and consequently get thrown in the drain and pick myself up and trust again.

title: My twin
content:
You've never responded to a playful joke with a legitimately hurtful comment? Kissed your ex-girlfriend even though you're not single and you know you shouldn't have even *seen* your ex? Refused to talk to your brother because of a fight you two had years and years ago? Have you ever disappointed yourself? Or even worse, *surprised* yourself?

You have an innate capacity for destruction/deception, whether physical, emotional or social. What do you struggle with? *Why* do you struggle with it? Explore that impulse. It may not be something that manifests itself violently or even outwardly.

As far as "understanding" the Nazis/USSR etc. A good starting place might be to look in to the working conditions involved in the production of whatever device you're using to access reddit. Slave labor for mining the rare earths. Suicides at factories. Are you going to throw your phone out now? No? Neither am I. *Especially* in today's media landscape, I would argue that part of incorporating your "shadow" means knowing when to "not care about certain suffering." It's about compartmentalizing/prioritization without becoming a bitter sociopath.

Don't start at "death camps." Start at the fact that you're (probably. not judging, but let's be honest) relatively inert as a ~~political~~ humanitarian actor. What have you done to help Haiti recently? How many homeless did you feed this week? Yeah, it makes you feel bad to realize you could "do more," but on the other hand, you *can't* care about everything. You can't take on the suffering of the world. Integrating the selfish/miserly portion of your shadow is how you learn to differentiate between "time to give" and "time to take" so that you're not either a thief or a chump.

See also: Freud's concept of sublimation.

title: MS#13: Just can't feel a thing
content:

You just work by negating whatever decision I took. Important, but not something to fancy.

I'm seriously bored. I cried last night. I think I subconsciously made myself cry. Because I was not even interested before or after this deed in the reason for which I cried. It's surprising that the unconscious can control my emotions to this extent. I just felt like crying, and I knew she is the only one capable of delivering the amount of pain I need for crying.

I want a change. I seriously want a change now. I'm fed up living this monotonous life. I want to be around friends of same interests. I want my life to be exciting. I want to function at my best. I want to progress. I want to live the life I always imagined. If the time's gone, I will seriously lose the chance to get it. And believe me I will regret it one day. Actually, I'm not sure, I may give up regretting altogether. Yeah, let's plan the days I would like having.

Let's first plan a single day: huh! I can't even think of a single thing that I would like doing here. Maybe I'm sick of this place. This is a wretched place, if not by appearance then surely by the life I lived here. It was a life of confusion, self-loathing, depression, loneliness and growing up.

I don't believe in anything I think nowadays. I can't pin-point the reason for anything that is happening. And the fact that one in fact cannot judge accurately the reason behind the thoughts that emerge out of his mind is making it harder and harder for me to get out of this bind. I want to believe that one can indeed tame himself but, the claim that Dostoyevsky put forward that the man would knowingly go against his own interest for no other reason but for the love of destruction and control, is enough to negate any claim.

I do want to live with Ajit in Hyderabad. But, I feel cynical even about that. He would love to have me, I guess. He knows he can talk to me of anything that aches him (I fucking hate my style of writing, if you even call this a style. I am in a serious need of reading shit ton of literature. It would help me with the upcoming english tests as well.) Anyways, I guess I'll be happy even if live in Saket. I don't mind, I guess I'm serious about not feeling anything anymore. Or It could be that the times are such that these feelings of anxiety is creeping on me. I rather leave this place first than they. So that it may feel that it was my decision, that I don't feel anything towards this place otherwise, why would I leave this place at my own will? Who knows what I actually wanted when this thought came to my mind, but it's for fucking sure that I'm not going to get an answer to this, after all, why did I had that thought? This is my paranoia.

I don't even feel happiness about the things I achieve. I guess this is because I've already achieved those feats many times before. And I know I've hit a plateau in programming. I need to go further in programming in order to make it feel rewarding. Like going deep into programming design and architecture or go balls deep in machine learning.

My life is actually among the good ones. I have most of the things people want... huh! again this self-gratification bullshit? Fuck that! Times are hard and I've proven to be relatively weak. I need to improve, I'm at the same place for a long time now. But do I have the motivation I need to go through all that is needed to achieve those feats. Take baby steps.

Think clearly. Maybe I'm not trolling myself, I actually need to read more.

I have no ambitions. I don't know what I want to do in life. Things will change and people will go and people will come. And friends will grow apart and more and more indifferent day by day. Everyone will be struck with agonies, ahh! such deep deep torments. The pain would last long enough to make them forget there identity. Ah! that lost identity again. Why do I feel so much pain when I think about this? I suspect it's something related to nostalgia. Maybe it's that I'm thinking what nostalgia I would feel in the future thinking about the past. But why? Because the present is good? The present identity is something to be lost? Not the past identity, not the identities that will follow this but, this one. I suspect it. After all, what makes this identity better that the others. And why should I ask to sacrifice future identities just to preserve present one? It's would be a sin to do that.

I always seem to fall in love with the image I make in my mind of someone. Although, the reality may be it's polar opposite I try to make situations the way they are in my dream. But they never change! And then comes the dark clouds over my head; depression, depravity, loneliness, self-loathing. I think the biggest one of these is loneliness. It was loneliness because of which I tried getting a girlfriend, not that I should need a reason for it. Taking a job would solve that.

Life will always be like this; dry and unsatisfying. We will always be in pursuit of something which we don't have, not value what we have at the moment forever dying to have something else, doesn't matter good or bad, just something new. We want to be seduced at all times with whatever that grips us to escape into meaninglessness, we know it's meaningless but it's still far better than feeling reality. Because reality is jarring. We find out that things are not in our control. You argue that we in fact do control our lives but, then what choice is left when the options are in itself controlled by the resources accessible to a person.

I don't have any ambition to be a writer, I want to be able to write just for the sake of the art. Isn't that the way things should go on? People's view would differ incessantly. Anyways, the technique I use to me make my writings seem any worth reading by at least myself: I try making the sentences as short as possible. Using words which express whole sentences. That does make seem my writings a little of quality to me. But, who am I to judge? I'm new in this field. I don't even know if the technique I use makes sense. I guess it does, it makes the sentences express the exact tone more accurately. I should write more. I would've made a list of things to do but, I know I won't follow it.

Loneliness man, it's loneliness for sure. I have everything man, everything. I got friends, I got family, I have good relations with everyone I care about, I don't feel left out and everything else in life is going smoothly. But there's an empty space. I do confirm that it's for that one person, wherever she may be. Are we being "hopeless romantic" now? Hmm, maybe, whatever.

If I die right now and here I don't think I would mind. Am I saying this because out of sheer naivete or have I actually foregone? Whatever. I wrote that after thinking the argument.

There were other ways to have fun, weren't there? Apart from programming and weed? Yeah, I had a group of friends to keep me in high spirits. I just am so sick of being night-bound. How long will this go on? Why I ever be the way I was before? I think not. Why I feel happiness again? To the extent I used to feel when I didn't knew the truth? All things point me in the same direction. I know I lack knowledge and perspective.

That I'm harmless, that I can be shouted upon and put to silence. All I want to say here is that you've found quite a handful amount of gold sitting beneath the wounded dragon! Another obvious revelation incoming! Thoughts on self-esteem and self-doubt are my own fears. Don't you see? You unconsiously know what you fear. And when she rejected you, you immediately feared of those things which you yourself fear.

As a conclusion and to the best of my undivided and unclouded judgement I think: I am not such a lowlife as I'm picturing myself to be, it's just self-loathing and I'm fun to hang around with. I SHOULDN'T JUDGE MYSELF TOO HARSHLY BASED ON RECENT EVENTS.

title: The fear of uncertainity
content:
I lost! I am so fucking lost! There's nothing worthwhile to do. I've seen it all, I've been through it all and I've lived it all. I have no ambitions really. Norway is just a thing I would like if it actually happens, but it's nothing like an ambition.

I've nothing to drive me, no reason to get out of bed. Every next day seems like a burden to somehow live, just to have yet another day thrown at you. I feel pathetic, depraved, desperate, lonely and most of all fearful. I have nowhere to go, what should I do at a time like this? Should I start asking for help from the wise? I should sincerely at least ask Ajit about what should I do? Now, to think of it; it seems if I need to ask this question from other people I might as well give up trying altogether.

Should I get a job and move away from this wretched place? why am I feeling this attraction to this place? There is nothing to keep me here anymore. All my friends are gone. My time here has been over quite a while ago. I shouldn't be staying here. But still even if I leave this place and get a job I'll have to come here for the exams. Oh! exams are going to be such a torture.

Man! Life's gotten weirdly painful lately. It's rare that I smile, I realized this just minutes ago. I feel like I've never been acquainted with happiness, ever. I sometimes feel an urge, a quick impulse just like lightening. I get it whenever I'm feel something that gave me joy in the past, like programming. Now to think of it, it's only programming that I'm missing from my life. I'm not able to get back to the life I used to live a year ago. I was consumed with desire to improve. I was progressing and I was happy! I used to remain happy 3-4 months on end. It seems unbelievable to me now.

Maybe this is a phase. I just need to get away from this place. That will cure the depression I'm sure. Getting a job would distract me, I'. what I would be missing if leave for the job would be friendship with him. Although, it's bound to happen. Not now then three months later. More importantly, do I need to be distracted from all this. I mean there's dragon but I can't see the gold. what is gold to me? Maybe I'm over-thinking this.

Maybe, I should just leave everything behind and go live with him in Hyderabad.

There's thought I keep having that rules all these problems harmless! The fact that most of my problems are not many but just one: having a hard time letting go. Things are going to change but remember, I have thought about all this and I have a plan in action. My future is more or less guaranteed to not suck as much as other peoples does. That was such a naive thing to say. You don't know when a catastrophy is going to come. The best you can do is have yourself prepared in advance. But that doesn't mean you won't be harmed. Things will come that will change your very soul. And if you are as naive as you are now? You are going to have a very hard time in the real world. I don't quite remember what I was writing.

Anyways, the thing I'm trying to say is: CHILL THE FUCK DOwn BRO. Shit happens. You know this is when you are only focused towards a particular facet of life. If something more intriguing come along my mind would wander towards it. And I will again see lights where I once used to see them. Therefore, I need to get away from here(period)

content:

People high in neuroticism tend to have deep negative thoughts and take more time than usual people to get over things, roughly speaking. I've been suspecting myself to be high in neuroticism recently.

As soon as I realized that I ACTUALLY am high in neuroticism, it immediately ignited confidence in me about my understanding of human psychology. These days more and more of my understanding are being proven to be right! Understanding and over-thinking (a trait seen in highly neurotic people) is my shit. But, I couldn't trust myself on anything because I had no confidence in myself regarding psychology. But now, hehe, I can!

I do need to study shit load of psychology, but it's good to see I am heading in the right direction. title: She's long gone
content:
And now it's finally the time when I'm supposed to feel pain of loss and rejection. She has completely stopped reaching out for me, finally given up on me. She has accepted our state of affairs and is trying to feel good again by keeping herself indulged in friends and activities.

I was waiting for this phase. The phase in which she stops giving me any importance. And now, it's my turn to feel the pain of losing her. Weed is not making it easier, on the contrary it's amplifying the agony of realizing that she's actually gone. So much misery, man! I still think, breaking away as early as possible was better choice. If I'm feeling this much pain, misery and restlessness after just 43 days of contact, what would have happened if I had continued this till June?

I know, I'm a coward. I have no excuse. I'm running away from pain and away from responsibilities.

But when I think about my pain and try to disect it to understand it better, I actually end up succeeding! A single situation can be interpreted in multiple ways. When I try to think the positive aspects, when I try to think of not what I've lost but, what I've gained, it makes the darkness clear space for some peace. There were reasons why I did this. This was the least painful of options.

At the end of the day, it comes down to two things. Firstly, being friends. And to that I say, fuck no! I don't see her as a friend. I think I have some issues with female friends, I just can't have them around. And secondly, being committed in a relationship. I've already mentioned, I don't want to spend my days being sired to her. Actually, this is my problem. More over I don't want the agony of losing my girlfriend to some bank manager or some policeman or whatever. We have no future. But, then again, who asked you to marry her? Just have a relationship with an automatic breakup waiting at the end while having someone else on the side just before totality. But still, I think there's much misery to be faced down that road as well. I won't be able to be with someone in a relationship without having real feelings. Lying is just too much work.

How will I ever find someone worth spending life together with if I cower away from giving them control over me? FUCK! I think I should leave this for a couple of years to figure out.

On understanding these feelings further, this pain of loss is nothing else but the urge for dopamine by the receptors in my hypocampus which has not been treated since 03JAN18. This is same as cocaine, except that drugs don't turn their backs on you, girls do. In case of drugs, the problem generally is money, addiction or overdose! And that's exactly why I'm feeling the loss, I just realized that she has given up on me. Up until now, my fix was available, she was right there, I was just resisting the urge. I had the control but now, my fix has turned her back on me, now I can't score dopamine even if I want to. I don't have the control. Hence, the fear.

Even after understanding my feelings and the importance of breaking away, I still feel the sadness. I think it's because of the sense of futility I have of breaking away from her. Why is there a need to break away? But, I need to understand, right now, I'm not seeing the big picture. All I'm seeing right now is futile destruction on my part, know that this is for a cause. If I don't break away now, my feelings towards her will grow without limits. The attachment would grow to the point I won't be able to see my life without her. But she is going to get married to someone else no matter what!

So long story short, just fucking suck it up. Time's are shitty, I know! It's meant to be shitty. Feel the misery, learn from it and move on.

title: MS#11: Conforming finally
content:
I'm not sad, I'm fine. I've terminated all mediums of contact with her. She hasn't stopped calling yet. I'm waiting for her to get mad at me and finally accept that we will never be anything more than strangers. The idea that this is the least painful way to get out of this mess remains undefeated by any claim. Therefore, I'll have to continue this. If I break now, I will be face to face with the place I'm dreading the most. I can't break now. I've come far, if I give up, I'll never come this far again.

I know I'm running. I'm fine with that. There is nothing much to gain if I keep pursuing this. It's hard not to feel for her. She doesn't deserve this neglegence. And to that as well, I can atleast say, pain's equal for both of us. Afterall, she always considered me as a friend. Should a 43 day friendship cause this much pain? And this's what I'm consoling myself with.

She just called twenty—fucking—eight times! In total, in the past 2 days, she has called around 150 times. Am I being a little too hard on her? Isn't 150 times a little too much? What should I do? If I talk to her, what will I say? I decimated every spec of respect and trust between us. Is there any possibility of us being friends even? But I just don't want to be friends. It feels like such a defeat. And on top of that, everything eventually has to end this very year. I feel like a fruad writing the last sentence on a 3rd January. Every time I look at my phone, I feel the anxiety similar to the day of my class seventh finals parent teacher meeting.

Many things could be drived from my past month's activity on this website. Almost all of the blogs I wrote had to be made personal for one reason or another. You know what this means, right? I've been having more interactions than usual, more personal interactions, about things that moves me. That has been hard to find these past couple of months.

I don't feel like wasting away. I mean, if I feel like being lazy about things, I would completely allow myself but, these days I don't feel like being lazy about certain things. I want to do them just because I want to. I want to see the other side, the side only a few have reached. There comes that sense of self-importance, to be dominant. But I need to understand, there is a dominance heirarchy at play everywhere, that's how groups in animals work.

I feel strong and confident. These days seem perfect to change big parts of myself. I'm at a point in my life where multiple facets of my identity need the same thing fixed for trancending further. Fixing that one thing would set many things in motion. It would be a big change for me because this thing is powerful enough to be the cure of nihilism! It's responsibility. It's what I need in my life. I've known this for more than a month now, it's really the time to go into that stuff. It even nutures the things I like such as, programming and philosophy. Why did I made it suspenseful? I'm the only one who would read this.

content:
Extremity

If I'm going in, I want to go all in. No more one foot out of the door. I want to focus on a specific thing and try to know all about it. I don't care what it is. Competitive programming, software development, music, psychology whatever it may be, if I am going to do it, I might as well take it to extreme.

I will struggle for a while regaining lost skills because of the 1.5 year break I just took. This year is going to be the year of insanity.

Healer

This is it! I've chosen this to be my life's purpose. I'm going to be a healer! I've known this for a quite some time, even before the "reform". I will learn further on human psychology and help heal burnt souls because sadly, I see them all around me. I hope this doesn't prove to be such a naive statement given time. everywhere there's fear".

to find our lonely love"
and

And only loved you for now

Tomorrow I must go"

title: The fall of hearts
content:
Times are dark. Things have not been good to any of my friends either. I would call this a full blown mourning period but, that feels like an exaggeration now. The closest friend of mine was having the worst time of his life while I was documenting my experience as "infinity". I'm writing this not for myself, not for my friend, not for the lonely love, but for the death of identity. My friend's girlfriend got forcefully married to someone else. This is first time I'm thinking about marriage and how the future is going to be. And as human's capability for negative emotions is much more than positive emotions; all I see in future is despair, heartbreak, pain and ever lasting misery and loneliness.

I want to write about the death of identity first. I'm talking about the girl I've been talking to for the last month or so. We have a deep understanding of each other. There's respect, love, attachment and most importantly trust. We share music, we talk about pain, of misery and we know we are never meant to be. She's going to get married right after college.

It's just so painful to picture her with someone else, to be his, completely his, whether she likes or not. I'm hoping she finds someone that she likes or atleast is in her power to be moulded into someone she could like. And the greatest tragedy of all, would be her lost identity, which she currently possess, will be lost then, if the guy she marries does not understand her. What if he doesn't value her? what if he doesn't realize her qualities? what if he treats her badly? She doesn't deserve that. She's innocent, she's harmless, she would be weak when she will be alone. How would she stand for herself when she would be bounded by her family itself?

I have this image in my mind of the far future which gets triggered immediately when I listen to "Phantasmagoria in two", a song that she recommended, in that image I see her walking the walk of life, doing life's mundane things and I suddenly show up. Oh! the emotions we would feel, of lost lives, of what could have been. Two pure hearts in purest form of love possible, bounded by time. She would gaze at me with a wide smile and with eyes that glitter at first and then get saddened the next moment. I would feel her love but, her identity? It would be long gone. Her impulsive behaviour, her untamed laughter, her crazy ideas, her warmth towards me, her understanding of mine, all weakened by trials of time.

It feels like such a waste. So much potential, ready to wither away. She deserves much more than that, a girl this real, original and kind deserves the highest order of freedom. Anyone who can notice anything would immediately notice her true side by the way she laughs. She laughs from her heart, she laughs with her whole body. She's not one to be caged, this can be felt in her laughter. Putting restrictions on her would be the greatest sin.

And then, she's so understanding, she tells me things about myself I have no clue of. She knows me, she knows that I'm by her side, she knows I love her and she knows it's pure. But I don't think she knows I am willing to stand by her side for the rest of our lives. I am willing to because she's that precious.

And then there's my friend, the monolith I was oblivious to. He has been by my side for years. Yet I was not able to know his misery. He still stands, showering love at everybody like he always does, and I was not able to see the wound he was walking with. Things this big should not be dealt alone, yet he walks freely and happily. How could he be that strong? so unimaginably strong? such circumstances that breaks even the strongest of men, he stands tall!

Its an inspiration. its staggering how amazing this guy is. I'm not saying this because he's my friend. I'm saying this because it's the truth. What he is going through, he can't even relate to anyone but to mere stories in movies. Not a single mistake from either of them yet both of them separated. The worst state would be his girlfriend's. She has nowhere to go now. She has deep, deep fued with her family, she's living with strangers and the one she loved has been completely and carefully separated forever.

I hope she gets through this. He has a plan, if only she could wait, they will be back together. It would be one of the happiest days of my life. The victory of love over society.

title: Loneliness is one persistent motherfucker
content:
Countless men have already tried to live away from humans, gave up on society (for obvious reasons) but, in the end all countless of them failed! Because ripping apart loneliness is akin to ripping yourself apart. It's in you, it's wired into you. My ideals, my heroes, people who have conquored themselves, everyone, failed. They all admitted in the end that a human can't live without another human. 350 million years of observation and yet no antidote. No one succeeded. Not a single fucking one.

I don't think I should go on my own to find the answer. I will find nothing. I'm not saying that it's throwing away time, I will learn things, but still, I don't want to. Rather, I believe the billions who have walked before me and try to implement the concepts that atleast avoid lonliness.

Today, it's just not about me, it's about everybody. Every single human that I observe, all I see in their eyes is the longing for some love and acceptance. But why? Why do we want it? It's really a very, very big question. A very, very big question that remains unanswered.

I've had enough of this bullshit loneliness. Fuck loneliness! (Well, mostly it's the other way around) This is no freedom. We are all collectively being domesticated by this urge to be longed for, to have someone beside us, to be cared about. Self-importance, validation, acceptance are all effects of loneliness. Every fucking human wants these. But, you see this doesn't end here. The birth of these emotion responding as a coping mechanism not only makes you feel shitty on your part but, it also wakes the demons upstairs. And before you know it you are in the center of this twisted spiral and all you can see is yourself being thrusted downwards into deep deep darkness. The demons possess you, lust, gluttony, greed, sloth, wrath, envy, pride they all come down at you like a waterfall bashing onto rocks, washing it away little by little, killing you, little by little.

What do I do? There are people who are actually approaching me with there problems (something I respect about them). These people, all have the same problem! The cause, situation and extent vary, but it's that same sneaky loneliness all over again. Even the people with social lives, I see them with their black clouds pouring over them while they walk their normal day in and out of city crowds. This is so tragic that it's almost feels like art.

The solution to something that's so us that we just can't afford to fight it. There is no way to rip this apart, so, the next best thing here is to give it what it wants. The key here is to make this supply of meds consistent.

title: The Seductiveness of Decay
content:
​

The question is, "should I put the hammer down on me? or not?". It's not an uncommon thought I've been having that I'm attracted towards depression. I like to sulk in loneliness and despair making up fantasies about how people dislike me in my victimized mind. I construct an environment around myself that feeds my depression, music much darker than my normal dark stuff, weed in order to push myself further downwards thus, achieving my goal of being complete, utterly and unfathomably empty. I have been successful in doing this.

The reason I give myself for torturing myself is that I'm facing the depression deliberately and it increases my capacity in taking more. It is a very sophisticated answer, except the fact that it is a complete lie. According to my past experiences, this habit of mine hasn't proved much beneficial. I get super depressed where my world is falling apart, people I give a shit to don't want to be with me, I see life's misery amplified and then I get back to normal where I find everything where I left it, including my mind. Depression is still in my control it's not the problem. I can regulate it whenever I want. The problem here is to figure out why do I want this? Hence, the question: " should I put the hammer down on me? or not?"

This attempt of mine to drown me in depression is not a template. When the real shit hits, it's not going to be like this one. I shouldn't think that I would be able to brave that just because I can with this one. It's not going to be like this, it would be much darker than this. By subjecting myself to depression I'm not gaining any valuable life lessons on how not to commit suicide.

title: Doubt
content:
Doubt is everything. Without doubt nothing would be possible. Doubt is the mother of invention and doubt is the downfall of empires. Doubt is also the only weapon a human has after his belief system collapses. Doubt is also the culprit behind the collapse of beliefs. Doubt is the anchor and doubt is manipulator.

I analyse people. I myself am the easiest subject I've found to analyse on. And let me tell you, there's a shit ton of things I've no clue as to why I'm doing them. Jordan Peterson said, "There are a so many things we do subconciously. We just don't understand human mind at all. That's the reason why psychology, philosophy and other such fields exist.".

I've never had my belief system collapse because I never had a belief system before. I never paid much heed to religion. I mention only religion as the belief system because it's the most widely accepted one. But there was a day when I realized the truth, it hit me hard because I remember I was very pain-ridden that day. I've always known there's no god (talking in trivial sense). That's the truth, hard and cold. But one day, I came to acknowledge that and it just blew my mind away. There is actually no god. I felt fear in some sense. How can such stupidity be the norm? Is everyone fucking stupid? Everyone I've ever known that believed in god, are those people just so ignorant and afraid of the truth that they rather live a lie? Don't they have their own mind to think for themselves before conforming to a cult?

It was in a sense the origin of my belief system. It's still not stable enough but, it has made progress. I'm currently running on it and it's hasn't been bad to me yet. Jordan Peterson's views makes sense to me. The biblical series he did, is one huge source of information. He is a student of mainly Carl Jung and Fredrick Nietschze. So, there's shit ton of existentialism, nihilism, pessimism, choas and order. I've been a critical thinker. When I came to know that I'm all alone, things mostly are fake and finding people who understand are far far less than expected. I had to make a belief system of my own. Something that's not mentioned even once in a lifetime of a person.

I was questioning everything. Everything that I've ever believed, everything that anyone has ever told and every single bit of information I took in. And my dead god, everything was a mess! There were days when I was not able to stay sober without losing it to agony. I remember I stayed sober for two days and I couldn't handle the anxiety. Those were the two days in which I realized that god is ACTUALLY fake. And more importantly that I live in a world which is so, so wrong.

Up until now doubt was the thing that kept me afloat. I quickly analysed every human behaviour I was curious about, I analysed quotes from great men but mostly I analysed myself. Each and every little action, the thoughts that came to my mind, my relations with others and with important people. Then quickly generalized it to my love, my passion, my desires, my darkness, my fears, my capabilitites. Figuring out a problem requires a lot of critical thinking. You just cannot let any imperfections pass. Because, it's binary. Either you are in delusion or you are not. It's delusion because when you miss even a single thing out, you come to a different conclusion. You got be hard on yourself. Things are not just complex, they are far much more than that.

But it's me who brought us to this. I'm willing to lose. If I want this girl I need to be straight forward with her. None of that bullshit I did with my ex.

I'm listening to Katatonia The fall of hearts. And god fuck this album is awesome! The songs are full of despairity, depravity, melancholy, barrenness and loneliness. Old hearts fall, Decima, The night subscriber and Passer are absolute masterpieces. Last song before the fade, Shifts, Takeover and Pale flag are next best songs, still weilding capability to turn a cheerful sunny day to a bleak lonely one. I've just been having shifts of dark emotions and thoughts. I guess I've found darkness. But I think it's not powerful. I feel like weed, katatonia and the girl are all doing their jobs just fine, but there's just no pain to fuck with.

Achieving rock bottom is growing tougher the faster the days. No childhood pain to feed off of and no anguish left to fuel the downward push. Weed alone isn't dark enough to push me further. The next awakening seems far, far away.

What is some one supposed to do when he has no ambitions, no goals, no worries and no pain? What to do if he is somewhat happy? And somewhat satisfied with his life? Such is my life. I see my faults as clear as a day. I avoid responsibilities. I don't have any excuses. I am wrong, I know that. But, I'm doing it anyways. Even if things go wrong. I know what my life is going to be if I don't do anything about it. See, there's a goal! Yes, but I'm not sure if I want it that bad. I know what has to be done in life to make it worth. I know that answer yet I am wasting away. Why do I want to be this way. I hear a calling in this meaninglessness. Or it could be just my laziness and my avoidance of responsibilities.

I think it's time now, even by my standards. I need to pull my own weight atleast. I feel shame in writing this. But, well, it's still me, it's what I've done. I don't know why I am doing this. There's a strong prefernce in me towards the fact that I'm just lazy, there's nothing wrong with me. I seem to live an ideal life at times. Then I choose to live a life in search of another rock-bottom. It's filthy. I sometimes judge myself in disgrace and forget that it's still me. Listening to my desires took me to this place. Is listening to your heart wise at all times? I don't think so. It's untamed, it will ask you to do whatever it wants. It's desires should be considered but not be made the rule of thumb. I really need to re-structure my life and life choices. Try to live a life with responsibilities.

Responsibility is the answer to nihilism. Responsibilities towards others, not towards myself for now. Actually, just responsible enough to not let my problems overflow me and onto others. But responsible for others is what I think worth living for. I know this. But, now that I know this, I immediately try to hide myself from it. As soon as I came to know about this, I shrinked. It's what I've been running all my life. Now that I know that's the answer, it's more frightening.

What should I do in this situation? Should I follow my rule and just give up on trying to be responsible and let time set me sail as I figure this out as I go further? Or should I be strict about this? And let no instance of irresponsibility pass by?

title: Katatonia: The Fall of Hearts Album Impressions
content:
its december now but winter has yet to arrive. even though i dont have dense fog to go with the album ive been saving for the last 5 months, ive started listening to Katatonia's the fall of hearts. it actually achieved what i expected it to achieve. its definitely a step forward for the band. they changed the sound a little bit. they have been experimenting with the sound, instruments, basically everything. as a result they've come up with a masterpiece. the songs are harder than the previous ones. but what's most remarkable is that the whole album is nothing like they have done before, this album feels completely experimental. songs like the night subscriber have riffs and melodies which ive never heard before. it not the sound but combination and transitions between riffs and melodies which is profoundly amazing. last song before the fade is a clear example of this. although no one expected their sound to morph in this direction but, every one knew to expect something new and different from this band. katatonia is not a band that rests on its past glories, instead they try to deliver something new and better and with the fall of hearts they surely did deliver.

ive listened to the second half of the album. songs like the night subscriber, passer, pale flag, last song before the fade and even shifts are all really good. most of the songs follow this pattern; heavy bass and drumming, directing lead guitar, clean vocals and some supporting instrument such as piano producing music of despair.

these new songs stand on their own. then to think that they are from Katatonia is making me even more humbled. ive chosen Last song before the fade to be the lead song. its the first song i heard in and out. its full of despair. Pale flag is another excellent song. its just unimaginable how creative this band can get. The Night Subscriber can be considered the direct underling of the yonkou that Last song before the fade is. surely stands on its own.

Last song before the fade is what divides the album in to two. i think this done consiously. because in the middle of the song there is a tone change. i think thats the real mid point of the album.The night subscriber is a behemoth. This song is like no other song ive ever heard. the riffs are in profound combinations. Pale flag exudes despair right from the start. it creates curiosity to know how the song will unfold. Passer is yet another good song. weird melodies prowerful enough to pull you towards them regardless of what youre doing.

The Night Subscriber
​I haven't yet heard the whole album in and out but this is most probably going to be my favorite song on the album. This song will depict pain, it tells you from the very start. The melodies clearly state that this song is not yet another song that you can just pass. Then clear vocals come in and lead us to our first "purge our will". Immediately after that ten hard blows are heard boldly stating that this song is not one of those that progress slowly to the heavy music. Heavy music is all this song's about. Clear vocals over heavy drumming and fast guitar carry the song further. The guitar work is peculiarly amazing. Especially when it's just guitar and vocals. Then comes the part where the song becomes entrenched in pain with several "purge our will" in a continuous progression. This part in its discrete form itself is spine-chillingly good. Then comes the second wall of ten heavy drum blows. A distant melancholic sound in the background starts subtly and stays until the end. Now the guitar which was being played in the background comes forward in full force. The guitar work is something to behold. The guitar towards the end is what got me into this song in the first place. The last minute of the song sees some lyrics with heavy guitar and drums. And the song ends without settling down.​

title: About
content:
As the clock struck mid-night I was sitting snuggled deep into my blanket in an upright position in the corner of my room listening to Red Hot Chili Peppers. I came to know it was new year when I heard the celebration. I was feeling good, the feeling of new beginnings kept me in high spirits. I thought at last this could be my break from the surmounting guilt of lost passion, for this would be my year! I will get back to Competitive Programming and practice even harder than the second-half of 2015. I felt like making new year's resolutions, I usually didn't believe in new year's resolutions or any type of resolution, aim or expectation at all, because I had failed at them countless times before. But that night, as I said the forgiving sense of new beginnings had already swept me away, so I gave it another try. Needless to say, I failed miserably but that comes later, will talk about that another time.

Among other new year's resolution one resolution was to document my life better, I felt there were way too many memories to hold in my head. I kept forgetting them if I didn't think about them in a long time. This fact in actual seriousness is scientifically correct. I made a plan to document my life better, although not knowing how to do it. My music history was being documented by last.fm which was one of the most important among the things to be documented. Another important thing to be documented was memories in the form of stories. This blog serves that purpose. I've named it Memory Sequences which is a term taken from the video game franchise Assassin's Creed. I started making this website on 21st July 2017 and I've documented the making process through out the week. That makes those blogs the first blogs on the website. Although I will be posting memories before the inception of this website which makes these memories technically older than the first blogs on the website. I've decided to sort the blogs in chronological order. This blog will serve as the description of the purpose and origin of the website.

This website serves as a means to document my life better, therefore needless to say whatever content is posted on the website is meant to be read by future me and that means most of the gory details and secrets won't be excluded from the blogs. Although, I have made this open so anyone interested can read this. Now, the type of blogs I will be posting here; actually, it's pretty simple; I will be posting anything that is important to me or I'm grateful for, three things mainly — music, philosophical findings, and memories. Other topics include skateboarding, books, and computer science stuff.

There are legends in every craft, crafts in which legends are the ones closest to perfection. But only in rare possibility does it happen that the legend somehow ends up saving the craft from it's demise by evolving the craft itself and making it as big as to be considered a part of mankind's history. The photo below is of Rodney Mullen, the man, the legend, the myth! Do you know? This dude single-handedly invented 270+ skateboard tricks. Tricks from the most basic to impossible (there's even a trick named Impossible invented by him). Many now common skate tricks were invented by him, back in 1982. If you can do tricks on a skateboards it is most definite that those tricks were invented by him. He is still alive and well and visits world campionships as a special guest and judge.

He even has given a TED talk. He talked about creativity in general and how he literally created freestyle skateboarding when it seemed skateboarding was taking it's final breaths in the early 1980s. He creatively brought skateboarding from parks and custom-made ramps to the streets. Even the shape of the skateboards was changed from flat to curve at both ends because he invented ollies and curved skateboards made it easier to do it.

There is much more he did for skateboarding than people know. The contribution which I consider the greatest and most radical was that he gave a platform, a craft to pursue for future skateboarders. He gave skateboarding a rebirth, skateboarding was now done on a totally different terrain and it was made possible by just an ollie! Ollie is when you push your backfoot such that the board jumps from the front while sliding the frontfoot from middle to the front end thus, lifting the whole skateboard. With the invention of ollie skateboards could now jump over curbs and other barriers. Then for easier ollies and it's variantions such as frontside shovit, backside shovit, kickflip, heelflip and other tricks which didn't used ollie such as pop shovit and primo slides, skateboards with curved ends became the mainstream. Afterall this was the skateboard which introduced a complete new dimension to skateboarding, the street!
title: Rodney Mullen: The Godfather of Skate boarding

"Rather than love, than money, than fame, give me truth." ― Henry David Thoreau, Walden

I am sometimes so furious at the morals and values elders preached about, about what is the good and what is bad, about what should be the values one should have, about what life goals one should have, about what success(money) is, about how people through insane hard work achieved their goals and how I should try to do the same. the philosopher
